item.title: NYS home care workers advocate for Medicaid reform
item.description: Home care workers and Democratic State Senator Gustavo Rivera rallied at the New York State Capitol to remove Medicaid long-term care from private insurers and save the state $3 billion a year with the Home Care Savings and Reinvestment Act.

item.title: New York lawmakers aim to bridge food aid gaps with state funds
item.description: Democratic state legislators and anti-hunger advocates rallied at the State Capitol to support including a food security package in the upcoming state budget, which would provide more state protections and funding for nutrition programs and welfare benefits following federal cuts to food access in New York.
